submission.justification: Absorber-F2 with 5.2 mm plate thickness provides the best energy resolution of 3.101% at 100 GeV among all tested configurations. This significantly exceeds the required 4.5% threshold and aligns with the goal of achieving the best possible energy resolution. The simulation explored all three candidate materials across the allowed plate thickness range (2-10 mm). Absorber-F2 consistently outperforms the other options, with Absorber-F3 achieving 3.795% at best (6.0 mm) and Absorber-F1 not meeting the 4.5% requirement at any thickness. The 5.2 mm thickness represents the optimum for Absorber-F2, balancing sampling fraction and shower containment.
